items.title: Dan Morgenstern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 9, 2013
items.q: It’s run by David Ostwald who is a lawyer who plays tuba, and it’s an Armstrong-dedicated band.

ctx.x: Right. As a matter of fact I did see her, I almost forgot, at the Jazz Educator’s conference in Atlanta in January she was there.

She’s very good. And she is surprisingly, and it matters that way too, they can play anything. I mean she knows Louis backwards. There’s a band in New York that plays every Wednesday afternoon at Birdland from 5:30 to 7:15. It’s run by David Ostwald who is a lawyer who plays tuba, and it’s an Armstrong-dedicated band. It’s called the Gully Low Jazz Band. It’s a Louis Armstrong memorial jazz band. So they play all Louis repertoire. But Bria, she knows all the stuff, you know, she can do a terrific job on the…
Let me check my camera here, and also check the time.
